title: Dr. Nikolaus S. Lang (Global Leader, BCG Henderson Institute) adds Incorruptible to his 2026 summer reading list
summary: Dr. Nikolaus S. Lang — Global Leader of the BCG Henderson Institute, Global Vice Chair of BCG's Global Advantage Practice, BCG senior partner (Munich) — adds Incorruptible to his 2026 summer reading list, highlighting Eric's focus on systems over individuals: how organizations can build the structures and governance to stay true to their purpose over time.
blockquote: What makes this book particularly compelling is its focus on systems rather than individuals. Rather than asking how leaders can make better decisions, Ries explores how organizations can build the structures and governance needed to stay true to their purpose over time.
blockquote_source: Dr. Nikolaus S. Lang on LinkedIn
attribution_title: Global Leader, BCG Henderson Institute · Global Vice Chair, BCG Global Advantage Practice · Managing Director & Senior Partner (Munich)
